BiblicalUsage: Nine — the number left behind. The shepherd leaves the ninety and nine to seek the one lost sheep in Luke 15:4 and Matthew 18:12, heaven rejoices over one sinner more than over ninety and nine just persons in Luke 15:7, and Jesus asks where the nine are when only one leper returns to give thanks in Luke 17:17.
TheologicalSignificance: I believe the ninety and nine are safe, but the one matters enough to leave them for. I would rather be the one leper who came back than one of the nine who never did.
